name: RemoveItemFromList
label: Remove Item From List
description: Removes an item from a list by index or value.

fields.name: RemoveMode
fields.label: Remove Mode
fields.description: Specifies whether to remove by Index or Value.

selectOptions.label: Index
selectOptions.description: Removes an item based on its position in the list.

selectOptions.label: Value
selectOptions.description: Removes an item based on its value.

fields.name: IndexToRemove
fields.label: Index To Remove
fields.description: The zero-based index of the item to remove.

fields.name: ValueToRemove
fields.label: Value To Remove
fields.description: The value of the item to remove from the list.

fields.name: SourceList
fields.label: Source List
fields.description: The list from which the item will be removed.

fields.name: ModifiedList
fields.label: Modified List
fields.description: Returns the updated list after removing the item(s).
